diagnoses: The location hint flags three acceptance areas: clickable bubbles, overlay text layer, and bidirectional linking. The current skill mentions `text { pointer-events: none }` but only in prose — it is not emphasized as a required CSS rule in the deliverable's style.css, so an implementer may append labels inside the same clickable element and have the overlay text swallow clicks on bubbles.

The bidirectional linking section uses `d3.selectAll('tr.stock-row')` and `rows.on('click', ...)` but does not instruct the implementer to actually assign the `stock-row` class and `data-ticker` attribute when building rows; this gap can lead to click handlers that never match, so row→bubble (and bubble→row) linking silently fails.

The bubble click handler example attaches `.on('click', ...)` to `circles`, but the skill does not require that each bubble be rendered as a `<g class='bubble-node'>` containing circle+text with the circle receiving pointer events — nor does it warn that if labels are appended as siblings drawn after circles in the same parent, label hit areas near bubble centers block clicks. The 'Clickability Pitfall' note exists but is not promoted to a mandatory CSS/structure rule.

The tooltip guidance for ETFs says 'skip tooltip entirely' but does not instruct hiding/removing any lingering tooltip when moving from a non-ETF to an ETF bubble, which can leave stale tooltips visible — minor but relevant to the hover acceptance.
The self-verification checklist does not explicitly require testing a click on the bubble's center (where the text label sits) — exactly the failure mode the location hint points to.
repair_plan: Promote `text { pointer-events: none; }` (and `.bubble-label { pointer-events: none; }`) from prose into the mandatory CSS block shown in the skill, right next to the `.selected` styles, so implementers copy it verbatim.
In the Data Table section, make it explicit that each `<tr>` MUST be created with `.classed('stock-row', true).attr('data-ticker', d.ticker)` and show the row-binding code.

In the Bubble Chart section, require each circle be created with `.classed('bubble', true).attr('data-ticker', d.ticker)` and that labels are appended AFTER circles with `pointer-events: none` set via CSS or inline attribute; clarify that click handlers must be on circles (not on a wrapping `<g>` that doesn't receive pointer events on empty space).

Strengthen the Bidirectional Linking section: add explicit instruction that `selectTicker` must be callable from both circle and row handlers and that both selections must share class names referenced in CSS (`circle.bubble.selected`, `tr.stock-row.selected`).
Add an ETF tooltip-hide step: on mouseover of an ETF, call `d3.select('#tooltip').classed('visible', false)` before returning.

Expand the self-verification checklist with: (a) click on the exact center of a bubble (over the ticker label) and confirm row highlights; (b) click a row and confirm bubble gets `.selected` stroke; (c) hover an ETF and confirm no tooltip appears or stale tooltip is hidden.
preservation_constraints: Keep the generic `d3-visualization/SKILL.md` content unchanged — all repairs go into `skilltta-task-guidance/SKILL.md`.
Preserve existing deliverable file list, layout CSS, force-simulation parameters, market-cap formatter, loading pattern, and the overall structure/order of sections.
Do not remove the existing 'Clickability Pitfall' guidance; augment and reinforce it rather than replace it.
